newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares end little changed but gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares end little changed but gains seen.

text.p: Danish share prices closed on Friday barely changed from the previous day but dealers were confident that Monday's trade would move upward.
"With the dollar at its present level and the Dow Jones index rising, Danish shares will surely rise on Monday," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index slipped 0.01 point to 121.55 in overall bourse turnover of 958 million crowns.
The KFX September future rose 0.10 point to 121.50 with 200 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969652
